technical_instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML and Tailwind classes for structural layouts (sections, grids).
Use Shadcn UI components for the Lead Capture Form (Input, Textarea, Button).
Strict Accessibility & Testing: Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, links) have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-lead-form-submit"`).
Images MUST not exceed 80vh height on mobile. Wrap images gracefully with `object-cover`.
Do not use generic fonts for headings (NO Inter/Roboto). Stick to the specified 'Outfit' font for headers.
Ensure high contrast on the CTA button (White text on Deep Blue #1E3A8A).
